description: Avrinningsområden dagvatten (Tekniska, Vattenförekomst) - Öppna Data is a dataset listed in National Single Information Point Sweden, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by dataportalen.stockholm.se. Avrinningsområden för dagvatten symboliserat på vattenförekomst med hänsyn tagna till tekniska system. Polygoner uppdelade på Utloppstyp - Utloppspunkt (i dagvattenledningsnätet), Reningsverk, Mark (diffus avrinning) och Odefinierad. Coverage: SE. Its keywords include Miljö, Sjöar och vattendrag, Fullständiga metadata, Stockholm Vatten och Avfall, Extern dataportal. The listing shows 4 download or service links in HTML, WMS_XML, WFS_XML. The listing shows 2022-04-06 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-nsip-se.
